claimLedger.lawName: 涉外民事法律適用法 / Act Governing the Choice of Law in Civil Matters Involving Foreign Elements
claimLedger.claim: Contract formation and effects follow valid party choice; absent effective express choice, the closest connection and statutory characteristic-performance presumption matter.
claimLedger.caveat: A Taiwanese counterparty alone does not make Taiwan law govern.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 涉外民事法律適用法 / Act Governing the Choice of Law in Civil Matters Involving Foreign Elements
claimLedger.claim: Ordinary use/consumption product harm relationship between victim and manufacturer defaults to manufacturer national law, with conditional victim selection of injury/place-of-purchase/victim-national law where manufacturer consented to or could foresee marketing there.
claimLedger.caveat: Preserve both foreseeable/consented marketing and victim election conditions; corporate recourse contract is separate.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 涉外民事法律適用法 / Act Governing the Choice of Law in Civil Matters Involving Foreign Elements
claimLedger.claim: IP rights follow law of the territory where protection is claimed; employee-created IP ownership follows applicable employment-contract law.
claimLedger.caveat: Do not claim one Taiwan agreement determines worldwide title or all upstream employees' rights.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 民法 / Civil Code
claimLedger.claim: Proper performance to creditor or authorized recipient, accepted, extinguishes obligation.
claimLedger.caveat: Bank transfer success alone does not identify an authorized recipient.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 民法 / Civil Code
claimLedger.claim: Payment to a third person has effects in listed circumstances: creditor ratification/later acquisition of claim, payment to quasi-possessor with debtor unaware of noncreditor status, or extent creditor actually benefits.
claimLedger.caveat: Three distinct routes; no automatic recovery or universal good-faith safe harbor. Chinese debtor wording controls.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 民法 / Civil Code
claimLedger.claim: Principal's own representation of authority or knowing tolerance of purported agency can create responsibility as if authorized, subject to third-party knowledge/could-know exception.
claimLedger.caveat: Spoofed appearance by fraudster alone is not automatically the principal's representation.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 民法 / Civil Code
claimLedger.claim: Contract may arise by express or tacit agreement; agreed essential points with nonessential gaps can be presumed sufficient.
claimLedger.caveat: Whether an actual PO/email accepted essential terms requires facts; not every email forms a contract.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 民法 / Civil Code
claimLedger.claim: When parties agree a specified form is required for contract formation, absence of that form creates a presumption of no contract.
claimLedger.caveat: Do not confuse effective166 with pending166-1.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 電子簽章法 / Electronic Signatures Act
claimLedger.claim: Compliant electronic records/signatures are not denied legal effect solely because electronic.
claimLedger.caveat: Other formation, authority and authenticity questions remain.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 電子簽章法 / Electronic Signatures Act
claimLedger.claim: Electronic-form rules include counterparty acceptance and the statutory notice/reasonable-opportunity-to-object mechanism.
claimLedger.caveat: Avoid claiming an email recipient always agreed to all terms.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 電子簽章法 / Electronic Signatures Act
claimLedger.claim: Qualified digital signatures can receive signature/seal presumptions under approved-certification-authority and valid-certificate conditions.
claimLedger.caveat: No blanket presumption for every scanned signature or foreign/EU certificate.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 電子簽章法 / Electronic Signatures Act
claimLedger.claim: Where law requires written retention, an electronic record may substitute if its content can be fully reproduced and retrieved later for inspection. Authenticity metadata may be retained with it.
claimLedger.caveat: Article8 paragraph2 permits metadata retention; it does not make every listed metadata item a mandatory condition. Keeping original emails/attachments/version history is practical evidence advice.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 專利法 / Patent Act
claimLedger.claim: Applicants without Taiwan domicile or business establishment must appoint an agent under statutory qualification rules.
claimLedger.caveat: Firm's patent-agent qualification is not established by general attorney service page.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 專利法 / Patent Act
claimLedger.claim: Invention novelty/nonobviousness rules include a12-month applicant intentional/unintentional disclosure exception; voluntary publication in a Taiwan or foreign patent gazette is excluded from that exception.
claimLedger.caveat: Grace period does not guarantee patentability, ownership or registration; design regime not covered.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 專利法 / Patent Act
claimLedger.claim: For the same invention, first lawful filing in reciprocal/WTO jurisdiction can ground priority when Taiwan filing is within12 months; earliest priority matters if multiple.
claimLedger.caveat: A separate clock from disclosure grace; neither extends the other.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 專利法 / Patent Act
claimLedger.claim: Priority declaration accompanies filing and certified first-filing documents are due within16 months from earliest priority; limited restoration rules apply.
claimLedger.caveat: Not an automatic restoration promise or general additional16 months to file.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 消費者保護法 / Consumer Protection Act
claimLedger.claim: Consumer definition is tied to consumption/use of goods/services.
claimLedger.caveat: Do not silently apply consumer scheme to an industrial B2B machine purchase.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 消費者保護法 / Consumer Protection Act
claimLedger.claim: Manufacturers and service providers must meet reasonably expected safety at supply given technical/professional standards and supply required hazard warnings; breach causing consumer/third-party harm can create joint liability.
claimLedger.caveat: No-fault proof may permit judicial reduction, not automatic total exemption.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 消費者保護法 / Consumer Protection Act
claimLedger.claim: An enterprise asserting requisite product safety bears the statutory proof burden; later improved goods alone do not prove old goods unsafe.
claimLedger.caveat: Maintain accident condition, testing, batch and warning evidence.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 消費者保護法 / Consumer Protection Act
claimLedger.claim: Distributors can share liability, subject to statutory due-care/unavoidable-harm defense; alteration/repackaging can change treatment.
claimLedger.caveat: Preserve seller exceptions rather than label every seller strictly liable in all cases.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 消費者保護法 / Consumer Protection Act
claimLedger.claim: Importer bears manufacturer responsibility under Article7.
claimLedger.caveat: Not a rule fixing final B2B contribution percentage.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 消費者保護法 / Consumer Protection Act
claimLedger.claim: Facts indicating a risk to consumer health/safety trigger immediate withdrawal of that batch/cessation of services, subject to sufficient necessary measures removing the hazard; required missing-warning cases are included.
claimLedger.caveat: Not every complaint automatically mandates recall; sector-specific reporting/certification not covered.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 消費者保護法 / Consumer Protection Act
claimLedger.claim: Liability under this section to consumers/third parties cannot be limited or excluded in advance.
claimLedger.caveat: Internal allocation/recourse between businesses requires its own contract and legal analysis.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 營業秘密法 / Trade Secrets Act
claimLedger.claim: Trade secret requires secrecy, actual/potential economic value from secrecy, and reasonable secrecy measures.
claimLedger.caveat: NDA alone does not turn every test record into a statutory trade secret.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 營業秘密法 / Trade Secrets Act
claimLedger.claim: Ownership of commissioned R&D secrets follows agreement; absent agreement contractor owns and funder may use within business.
claimLedger.caveat: Not every evaluation/test is commissioned R&D.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 營業秘密法 / Trade Secrets Act
claimLedger.claim: License territory, time, content and methods follow agreement; sublicensing requires owner consent.
claimLedger.caveat: Specify affiliates and outside testing labs; physical access and legal permission are distinct.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 營業秘密法 / Trade Secrets Act
claimLedger.claim: Misappropriation includes improper use/disclosure in listed circumstances, including information lawfully received under obligations.
claimLedger.caveat: Lawful initial receipt does not authorize every later use.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 營業秘密法 / Trade Secrets Act
claimLedger.claim: Owner may seek removal/prevention of infringement and destruction of infringing things or other necessary measures.
claimLedger.caveat: No universal automatic statutory right to return/delete every device, copy or test result; design contract obligations separately.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 著作權法 / Copyright Act
claimLedger.claim: Computer programs are included in listed types of works.
claimLedger.caveat: Protection of specific work still requires statutory conditions.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 著作權法 / Copyright Act
claimLedger.claim: Copyright protects expression, excluding underlying ideas, procedures, systems, operating methods and principles.
claimLedger.caveat: Do not claim ownership of every functional idea through copyright.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 著作權法 / Copyright Act
claimLedger.claim: For nonemployment commissioned works, creator is author unless agreement designates funder; economic rights follow agreement and default to creator, while funder may use under paragraph3.
claimLedger.caveat: Payment is neither automatic full assignment nor zero rights. Paragraph3 use is distinct from a contractually defined Article37 license.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 著作權法 / Copyright Act
claimLedger.claim: Economic rights may be wholly/partly transferred; unclear scope presumed untransferred.
claimLedger.caveat: Source-code delivery is separately agreed, not automatically accomplished by abstract transfer wording.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat

claimLedger.lawName: 著作權法 / Copyright Act
claimLedger.claim: License scope follows agreement; unclear scope presumed unlicensed and nonexclusive sublicense requires owner consent.
claimLedger.caveat: Do not erase Article12(3) statutory use; separately evaluate third-party maintenance and modifications.
claimLedger.status: current-effective cited provision; see source-level commencement caveat
